name: Alex Gomez
life: “I still remember burning dumplings the morning I left home.” People around Ferris Deli know Alex by a small Tuesday habit. Alex asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I sat in the wrong laundromat listening for it. A stranger walked me all the way here.
appearance: Alex has a wide brow and a narrow jaw. Look for a high puff tied with plain cord. Away from the heat of the kitchen, the familiar outfit is a charcoal zip cardigan with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair. In conversation Alex counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Alex has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To thank the stranger who found the correct shop.
family: Dana Sanders is Alex’s parent’s cousin. Alex asks before bringing somebody along. Dana can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *A summer marriage*, Dana says, “I sew uniforms. The couple asked for formal clothes they can go straight back to work in.”
connections: Lucia Starr. The dancer gives the lost visitor directions to a morning rehearsal.

reactions.situation: A tired neighbor asks the singers to move
reactions.response: Alex asks when the neighbor sleeps and helps arrange a quieter hour.

reactions.situation: A diner goes silent in the middle of a noisy family celebration
reactions.response: Alex takes a small plate to the quieter end of the table and saves the seat beside it.

reactions.situation: When a private quarrel becomes a public joke
reactions.response: Alex says the plainest truthful thing possible and changes the subject.
